lea.text: Jared Carthalion is given the Moxen, along with Kristina, by Liana during her duel with Ravidel so that he will not take them.
At the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor, Ravidel uses three of the Moxen to activate the Mox Beacon against Jared and his allies.

leg.text: Jared grows up a beggar in Arathoxia, raised by Ezer, and after Ravidel conquers the city he steals the Lotus, leads refugees against Ravidel at Castle Melmereth and summons a Shivan Dragon.
Kristina takes him in and teaches him all mana, and they fall in love.
When Jared learns that Ravidel is alive, Liana dies and Ravidel activates the Mox Beacon, which starts the Planeswalker War.
Jared battles Ravidel at the Dueling Chasm, ascends as a planeswalker and saves Kristina, though Altair dies, and he likely loses his immortality in the Great Mending.

hml.text: In Homelands, Jared's father Adam is defeated by Ravidel and entrusts his spelltrove and the infant Jared to Ezer before destroying Ravidel's barge and himself with Inferno.
Seven years later, Jared disintegrates a berserker with a scroll from his father's spelltrove and Ezer names him the Shadow Mage, and at fifteen he summons a minotaur that gifts him Foecleaver.
After Jared steals the Black Lotus and Ravidel attacks Arathoxia, the dying Scarlet Vizier tells Jared his mother was murdered, and Jared swears vengeance on Ravidel.

In Castle Melmereth, Jared annihilates Narok and crushes the Black Lotus to summon a Shivan Dragon that destroys the castle, and afterward he shares a kiss with Liana and leaves to learn new magic and become a Wayfarer.
